column1: # Localization strings read off genuine gameplay footage, because no config
# revision that survives defines them. One row per string:
# Casing is as it appears on screen. None of these labels carry "all-caps" in
# their layout except FUT_CHAPTER_LOCKED, so what you see is what is stored.
# Chapter names. Genuine footage shows the chapter cell reading
# "1. Omicron Persei 8 Story Missions" and "1. Mars Story Missions" -- the
# leading number comes from FUT_SPACEMAP_NUMBERED_NAME, the rest is the
# chapter's own name string. The planet names are our own LocalData; the
# " Story Missions" suffix is what the two frames show.
# The Daily Planet's chapter name. NOT read off footage -- no frame we hold
# shows it. The 1.5.x set splits planet 16 into one chapter per weekday
# and only one is ever visible, so they share this key.
